watch.summary: The creator accidentally scores an own goal in Rocket League and laughs hysterically at his mistake before answering a chat question.

beats.what: The creator is defending his goal in Rocket League.
He hits the ball directly into his own net.
He bursts out laughing at his own blunder.
He goes back to playing and answers a question about playing with viewers.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: That is not limit in my own mistake!
watch.why: An accidental own goal followed by genuine, uncontrolled laughter provides a quick, universally understandable self-own. However, the clip keeps going into ordinary gameplay and chat interaction, losing the comedic focus after the initial laugh.
